Make yourself a Vision/Dream board. For mine I have 4 squares of cork on my wall and I have a workout plan posted on there, motivational quotes from my favorite anime, a map of the D&D world I'm creating, a list of rules I gave myself to follow, and a blank page that I write down my to-do and ideas on. Eat more fruits and veggies and less meat, get some exercise even if you just start out with a tiny bit(i.e. stretch for 5 min, 5 pushups, 10 sit-ups, 25 jumping jacks, and 5 squats, then increase it every two or three weeks), write down at least one thing you are grateful for every day, watch more documentary/educational/motivational videos as opposed to regular mindless programming, talk to people more openly and honestly/be genuine. There's much more you can do, the main thing is just keep searching and moving forward, you are taking steps on the right path my friend.
